title: Modified function request to send the session token
context: The storefront sent every request to its API without saying who the shopper is. Each request now carries the session token of the browser tab, when the tab has one. A tab with no token sends the same requests as before.
- **When** a shopper whose tab holds a session token opens the catalogue, **then** [the products request carries an `Authorization: Bearer` header with that token](code:src/api/client.ts#L29).
- **When** that shopper opens the account page, **then** [the request that reads the profile carries the same header](code:src/api/profile.ts#L5).
- **When** that shopper saves the profile form, **then** [the `PUT` request that writes the profile carries the same header](code:src/api/profile.ts#L9).
- **When** the tab holds no session token, **then** nothing changes.
- **When** the API answers a request with an error status, **then** nothing changes.
- **When** a shopper opens the cart, **then** nothing changes.
- Added [`SESSION_TOKEN_KEY`](code:src/api/client.ts#SESSION_TOKEN_KEY), the constant `"storefront-session"` that names the `sessionStorage` entry of the token.
- Added [`readSessionToken()`](code:src/api/client.ts#readSessionToken) to return that entry, or `null` when `sessionStorage` has none.
- Modified [`request()`](code:src/api/client.ts#request) to add an `Authorization: Bearer` header when the token is not `null`, before the headers of its caller.

The server that answers the catalogue now receives the token of the shopper.

waypoints.title: Added the name of the `sessionStorage` entry that holds the token
waypoints.reading: The author added a constant `SESSION_TOKEN_KEY` that holds `"storefront-session"`, the name of the `sessionStorage` entry the session token is read from. [`readSessionToken()` passes it to `sessionStorage.getItem()`](code:src/api/client.ts#L20), so that [`request()`](code:src/api/client.ts#request) can send the token. No file of the repository writes that entry.

waypoints.title: Added a function that reads the session token from `sessionStorage`
waypoints.reading: The author added a function `readSessionToken()` that returns the `sessionStorage` entry `"storefront-session"`, or `null` when `sessionStorage` has no such entry. The function is not exported. [`request()` calls it before every `fetch`](code:src/api/client.ts#L24), so that each request sends the token that is stored when the request starts.

waypoints.title: Modified `request()` to send the session token as a Bearer header
waypoints.reading:
The author modified a function `request()` that now:

- calls [`readSessionToken()`](code:src/api/client.ts#readSessionToken) before the `fetch`
- adds the header `Authorization` with the value `Bearer ` and the token when the token is not `null`, and adds no header when the token is `null`
- spreads `init?.headers` after that header, so an `Authorization` header of the caller replaces it

[`fetchProducts()`](code:src/api/products.ts#L5), [`fetchProfile()`](code:src/api/profile.ts#L5) and [`updateProfile()`](code:src/api/profile.ts#L9) call `request()` and pass no `Authorization` header, so that the products request and both profile requests carry the token with no change in those files.
waypoints.needsAttention: This is the change the pull request exists for: every request to the API goes through `request()`, so the header it adds reaches [`src/api/products.ts`](code:src/api/products.ts#L5) and [`src/api/profile.ts`](code:src/api/profile.ts#L5). The other two waypoints of this file supply the token.
